jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Test Infrastructure
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft Orbital, we have just successfully launched multiple satellites that we fly and operate ourselves. With these satellites in orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly as a global company. We are looking for a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO and Toulouse, France sites. About this role: As a Test Infrastructure Engineer , you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is: Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us! Able to wear multiple hats as needs arise. We are a small company disrupting an entire industry! Not afraid to get out of their comfort zone to explore and learn. Technologies are evolving at rapid rates, and we must stay relevant! Key responsibilities include: Design, build, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity Hardware-in-the-Loop ( HIL ) testbeds that emulate spacecraft systems, sensors, and communication links. Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns. Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone. Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms. Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests. Troubleshoot complex system issues spanning software, embedded hardware, networking, and system configuration. Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally. Must Haves: 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals ( OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP ). Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar). Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools. Experience containerizing applications with Docker. Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines. Nice to Haves: Experience designing or automating complex HIL / SIL testbed, signal conditioning, fault injection, or hardware emulation. Experience with “Infrastructure-as-Code” systems, specifically NixOS. Familiarity with networking simulation tools (e.g., network emulators, virtual switches) for testing data flows under realistic mission constraints. Interest or experience with hardware test automation frameworks (e.g., custom Python-based test rigs). Master’s degree in Computer Science or a similar field. Some of Our Awesome Benefits: Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best Health and life insurance, we care about your health Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand ) Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable * Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes. jobs.description: Test Engineer - Output-/CCM-Systeme Für unseren Kunden aus Bern , suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n, motivierte:n und aufgeschlossene:n Test Engineer - Output-/CCM-/Dokumenten-Management-Systemen. Diese 50% Position kann möglicherweise mit der Test Management Position (ebenfalls 50%) kombiniert werden. Deine Aufgaben: Analysieren der bestehenden Dokumentenlogik und Ableiten von Testfällen, insbesondere für komplexe regelbasierte Varianten (if-then-else-Logik, Textbausteine, Datenanreicherung) Konzipieren und Umsetzen eines automatisierten Alt-/Neu-Vergleichs auf Basis des XML-Datenstroms aus OUTPUT (Vergleich von Inhalt, Layout und Ausgabeformaten) Erstellen und Pflegen von Use-Case-basierten Testdaten (synthetisch oder anonymisiert) für die relevanten Geschäftsfälle Mitarbeit beim Erfassen der Dokument-Trigger sowie beim Aufbau von Testmechanismen für zeitgesteuerte, nicht manuell auslösbare Dokumente (z.B. Mahnungen) Durchführen von Integrations-, End-to-End- sowie Performance- und Massentests (Volumen von ca. 100 Mio. Seiten pro Jahr) Prüfen der Ausgabe über alle Kanäle (physischer Druck, digitale Kanäle) inkl. Ausgabesteuerung, Bündelung und Jobverarbeitung Fehleranalyse, Dokumentation und Nachtesten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Entwicklung; Unterstützung der Fachbereiche im UAT Dein Profil: Ausgewiesene Arbeitserfahrung als Test Engineer im Bankenumfeld Sehr gute Kenntnisse in XML, XPath/XSLT sowie SQL und im Umgang mit grossen Datenmengen Ausbildung/Zertifikat ISTQB Foundation Level, idealerweise Advanced Test Automation Engineer (oder vergleichbar) Kenntnisse im Bereich Customer Communication Management / Output-Management Erfahrung in Erstellung und Management von Testdaten, inkl. jobs.title: Manual QA Engineer (Game Client)
jobs.description: Playson is a leading online gaming supplier, founded in 2012, which has developed worldwide recognition in the industry. We offer complete gaming solutions based on the latest technologies and detailed market analysis for the leading iGaming operators. We are seeking a highly skilled Manual QA Engineer to join our Game Client squad with a robust understanding of QA theory and agile methodologies. The ideal candidate will have a background in iGaming or general game development, and will be responsible for ensuring the highest quality of our products. What will you be doing?: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts; Perform manual, functional, regression, mobile, and cross-browser testing to ensure a seamless user experience; Document and track software defects, collaborating closely with developers to resolve issues; Execute testing in a client/server architecture environment; Maintain and improve established workflows and procedures within agile teams; Integrate and utilize continuous integration (CI) tools such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions to streamline the testing process; Collaborate closely with cross-functional team members (including mathematicians, sound producers, artists, designers, and animators) to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues. Required Skills and Experience: 4+ years of experience in manual testing; Strong knowledge of QA theory and agile methodologies; Experience in iGaming development or game development in general; Proficient in manual, functional, and regression testing methodologies; Proven experience with mobile and cross-browser testing; Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail and a strong overall vision; Practical experience in writing detailed test documentation; Familiarity with testing client/server architectures; Experience working with tools like BrowserStack or similar services; Hands-on experience with automation testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Jest, Pytest); Basic proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript; Experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman or similar; Experience with Zephyr and/or TestRail. Would be beneficial to know: Familiarity with observability systems like DataDog and Grafana; Experience working with Databases, including SQL, NoSQL, and analytical databases. What you get in return: Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive salary in EUR, subject to annual performance reviews; Quarterly Bonuses: Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system; Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs; Remote Work Option: Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort; Medical Insurance: Receive comprehensive medical insurance for both you and a significant other; Financial Support for Life Events: We provide financial support during special life events; Unlimited Paid Vacation: Enjoy unlimited paid vacation leave; Unlimited Paid Sick Leave: Take unlimited paid sick leave whenever necessary; Professional Development: Get reimbursement for professional development courses and training. If the job description rings a bell - take action and apply! Looking forward to welcoming you to the iGaming world! Ambitious goals request a quick ability to maneuver through changes in the world. Playson is all about that. Join us today! #LI-DNI

jobs.title: AI & Automation Lead (f/m/x)
jobs.description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor. lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months. We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you. Your Mission: As AI & Automation Lead, you will establish and lead lemon.markets’ first dedicated AI function, making AI a safe, practical and measurable part of how the whole company works. Reporting directly to the VP Engineering and operating across the first line, you will identify high-value opportunities across Engineering, Finance, Operations, Compliance, Product, Sales, Partner Management and People and turn them into solutions that improve efficiency without compromising quality or control. You will build on the foundations already being established, including a governed AI platform, an inventory of current use cases and an initial risk assessment aligned with the EU AI Act. A key part of your role will be creating the standards, measurement framework and decision processes that determine which use cases are scaled, improved or stopped. Working closely with Engineering, Finance, Risk Management and Compliance, you will balance innovation with data protection, operational resilience, cost discipline and regulatory expectations. This is your opportunity to shape how a regulated financial company adopts AI responsibly, while building a function that leaves lasting capability across the organisation. In this role you will Lead the AI function and work with department heads across lemon.markets to identify, prioritise and deliver use cases that create measurable business value beyond Engineering. Build a transparent, evidence-based portfolio of AI initiatives with business owners, baselines, success metrics and appropriate guardrails, ensuring that promising ideas become sustainable improvements. Enable teams across the company to use AI effectively themselves by developing practical workflows, guidance and capabilities that reduce manual effort without creating dependency on the AI function. Set the standards for our governed AI platform with Engineering, including model selection, evaluation, access controls, data protection, human approval points and reliable fallback processes. Partner with Risk Management, Compliance and Finance to ensure AI use cases meet regulatory expectations, remain within agreed risk and cost boundaries, and receive the appropriate independent review and sign-off. Establish a measurement framework that connects efficiency gains to quality, risk and customer outcomes, enabling clear decisions about when to scale, improve or stop an initiative. Lead and grow a team of AI Engineers and Data Scientists, setting priorities and using demonstrated demand and measurable impact to guide future investment. You’ll be successful in this role if You have shipped applied AI or data solutions into production and managed use cases from discovery through implementation, measurement and improvement. You have driven adoption beyond Engineering , helping teams such as Finance, Operations, Compliance, Sales or Product improve how they work. You have experience in a regulated or highly controlled environment and understand the importance of governance, independent scrutiny and clear lines of responsibility. You are rigorous about measurement , establishing baselines, defining quality guardrails and assessing the full impact of a solution before scaling it. You understand the economics of AI , including inference costs, model routing, evaluation and the difference between an assistant and an autonomous workflow. You are technically credible and hands-on enough to work effectively with engineers , with a working understanding of topics such as retrieval, access controls, evaluation and AI security risks.
